# Reporting a security concern

Please email **iman.rammal@gmail.com** for security concerns. Avoid posting sensitive details in a public GitHub issue.

Include the Clear Read version, Windows version, a short description and minimal reproduction steps. Use synthetic documents where possible. Do not send API keys, passwords or private document contents.

Version 1.0.0 is currently prepared but unpublished. This policy does not announce a public release, certify security, or promise a response time. The author will review reports and determine the appropriate next steps.
